 Yim Si-wan stars as a corporate heir suspected of murder, while Seol In-ah plays a female detective who pretends to be his male bodyguard
 3 -MIN READ 3 -MIN Listen Pierce Conran in Seoul Published: 7:15pm, 23 Oct 2026 Lead cast: Yim Si-wan, Seol In-ah, Kim Jung-hyun, Yeonwoo
 Latest Nielsen rating: 4.7 per cent
 In the romantic comedy Love in Disguise , Yim Si-wan plays a vain corporate heir suspected of murder who hires a new personal bodyguard, unaware that his protector is actually a female detective in disguise (played by Seol In-ah of Business Proposal ). The series marks a return to more conventional K-drama fare for Yim, following his intense roles in the action film Mantis (2025) and the second and third seasons of Netflix’s Squid Game .
